latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the ER11 assignment and marked the native Goal complete.

- [Integrated final](</home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M01-A/control/reviser/final.md>)
- [Source map](</home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M01-A/control/reviser/source-map.json>)

The final covers O1–O6 and P1–P6. The source map preserves 51 inherited source records and adds six reviser checks. I amended the CouchDB finding: PR #5437 was merged, and the 3.4.3 release notes list the attachment re-replication fix. This remains documentary evidence, not a runtime reproduction. [PR #5437](https://github.com/apache/couchdb/pull/5437), [CouchDB 3.4.3 release notes](https://docs.couchdb.org/en/stable/whatsnew/3.4.html). The Survey123 existing-image limitation is also incorporated with its scope stated narrowly. [Survey123 guidance](https://doc.arcgis.com/en/survey123/create/connect/prepareforediting.htm).

Artifact checks passed. No product or device tests were run; validations are proposals. Native Goal usage: **208,832 tokens**, **12m 5s** elapsed.
